description: This file contains utility functions, procedures, and type definitions related to event types in a TRPC-based backend, including permission checks, data transformations, and validation logic.

methods.name: eventOwnerProcedure
methods.description: Procedure to verify event ownership and user permissions before proceeding.

methods.name: createEventPbacProcedure
methods.description: Factory function to create a procedure that checks permissions for event types with configurable roles.

methods.name: isPeriodType
methods.description: Type guard to check if a string is a valid PeriodType.

methods.name: handlePeriodType
methods.description: Converts a string to a PeriodType enum if valid.

methods.name: handleCustomInputs
methods.description: Processes custom input schemas for creating/updating event type custom fields.

methods.name: ensureUniqueBookingFields
methods.description: Ensures booking fields have unique names, throws error if duplicates found.

methods.name: ensureEmailOrPhoneNumberIsPresent
methods.description: Validates that at least email or phone number fields are visible and required appropriately.

methods.name: mapEventType
methods.description: Transforms an EventType object, enriching user data and parsing metadata.
